'''Royal K Hotel and Casino''' was a business owned and run by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kassar Kosciusko]]. It was located on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].
